name: Hamming Weight of Sum of Squares
description: Replaced the algebraic polynomial $6S - S^2$ with a process that calculates the Hamming weight of the binary representation of $p_u^2 + p_v^2$. This forces the LLM to trace the bitwise logic for the discrete domain {1, 2} rather than relying on algebraic pattern matching or taking derivatives, while still enforcing exactly the same bipartite graph condition.
